blocks.alt: Working of Decimal to Binary During Function Call

blocks.content: Now, since the function has reached the base case, the recursion comes to a stop. The program control returns to the previous recursive call (the second-last function call), which then prints its remainder value.
After that, the program control returns to the third-last function call, which prints its remainder value, and so on.

blocks.alt: Working of Decimal to Binary When Returning Values
